sentences.text: Prevotella merdae is an anaerobic, Gram-negative, rod-shaped, non-motile bacterium that does not produce spores, proposed as a novel species from strain Marseille-P4119.
Its type strain was isolated from a faecal sample of a healthy 32-year-old faecal transplant donor.
Its genome assembly was 3,912,650 base pairs with 44.4 mol percent G+C content, 3,094 protein-coding genes and 74 RNA genes.
Prevotella stercorea was reported as the phylogenetically closest species with standing in nomenclature, sharing 97.10 percent 16S rRNA sequence identity.
In a trial of faecal microbiota transplantation with an anti-PD-1 inhibitor, a strain called Prevotella merdae Immunoactis was isolated from a responder and stimulated T cell activity in mice.
